name: Battery & Electrical Starting System
disclaimer: Battery acid and jump starting carry short-circuit and chemical risks. Always advise following owner manual safety procedures.

symptoms: Rapid clicking sound when turning key / pressing start button
Instrument cluster lights flicker or dim
potentialCauses: Loose or corroded battery terminal cables
subtopics.criticalWarning: Check for battery swelling, cracking, or strong sulfur/rotten egg odor. If swollen or leaking acid, DO NOT attempt to jump start.
triageQuestions: Do you hear a rapid clicking sound or complete silence when trying to start?
How old is the current 12V battery (more than 3-4 years)?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Battery load test and terminal inspection, jump-start assistance if safe.

symptoms: Car battery dies overnight or after sitting 1-2 days
potentialCauses: Parasitic electrical drain (interior light, dashcam, faulty module)
triageQuestions: Did any interior light or accessory stay on?
Was the car driven on regular highway trips recently?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Battery charging system health test & parasitic draw analysis.

symptoms: Red battery light illuminates on dashboard while driving
Electrical systems shutting down one by one
subtopics.criticalWarning: If the battery light is on while the engine is running, the alternator is NOT charging. The car will die completely once the battery drains in 10-30 minutes.
triageQuestions: Is the battery icon on while the engine is running?
Do you smell burning rubber under the hood (possible broken accessory belt)?
subtopics.recommendedAction: Drive directly to service center immediately or pull over before vehicle loses all electrical and engine power.

triageRules: Instruct customer never to touch leaking battery acid with bare skin.
Offer mobile jump-start service or shop battery replacement.
